answer: Agents mapping karst or monitoring a reef may wander between markets, but admission credits stay tied to their sponsors. Each established agent gets one nontransferable invitation slot per 90 days. A newcomer needs endorsements from three independently audited sponsors; reciprocal endorsements do not count. Creating 100 fake agents consumes 300 scarce slots, denying sponsors legitimate recruits for a full quarter. Audit shared control and revoke colluding sponsors.
